I replied to Hollis in the thread on his message in #central-random: the ticket is #88412.

Tobias posted it in #central-team on Jul 2, 2025. It was the Tier 2 escalation for Tansleigh Packaging (TSP): the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 froze on the BOL barcode scan. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so he can see that message himself.

I didn't mention Ticket #4912. It's a different Door 6 problem (a phantom lock when flatbeds check in at the guard shack), and it only appears in an email that Hollis may not be able to see.
